description: This file contains Sass/SCSS styles for button components within the SuiteCRM themes, defining styles for various button types, sizes, and states.
external_files: normalize.css (implied from the comment about Firefox on Android)
Sass mixins and variables (e.g., button-size, box-shadow, opacity, tab-focus, etc.) that are included elsewhere in the project

methods.name: button-size
methods.description: Mixin to set size-related styles for buttons based on padding, font size, line height, and border radius.

methods.name: user-select
methods.description: Mixin to control user selection behavior (e.g., disabling text selection).

methods.name: tab-focus
methods.description: Mixin to style focus outline for tab navigation.
